blocks.text: **Tilde is a business card for a tap or a scan.** On your Android phone, it’s an app: hold your phone to someone else’s and they get your contact card, your website or your WhatsApp. To hand out, it’s a card or a tag you print yourself, with a QR code and an NFC sticker inside.

items.text: **Tap or scan.** The other person doesn’t need an app, and any phone camera reads the code.
**The app is free and open source,** with no account and no internet: your details stay on your phone until you share them.
**Print what you hand out,** or pick up a tag at our booth.
